title: Deeper/broader ACIS writer version-boundary and FreeCAD consumer-profile review
scope: Public-source research to refine existing S8.4/S8.5 ACIS carrier and FreeCAD consumer gates. No peer checkout/build/run, native CAD/kernel run, fixture, or local test was performed.

observations: PR remains open and is not a released capability result.
Author describes pre-2013 inline SAT and R2013+ ACDSDATA/AcDs SAB routes for DXF/DWG.
Author reports a directory-position versus sorted-handle-rank defect found with unsorted records.
Author reports SAT chunks split at whitespace so a token does not span group 1/3 values.
Author reports AcDb3dSolid subclass/history field begins at R2007, and says DXF targets R2000/R2004/R2007/R2010/R2013 opened in TrueView.
The branch does not support R2007 DWG writing; its described DWG header handling includes AC1018+ empty AcDs section behavior.
limits: These are branch-author reports, not normative ODA conclusions or independently reproduced runs.
No branch build, code diff audit, output artifact, or consumer run was performed in this research pass.

observations: Separate maintainer proposal for Region, CadBody, and Solid3D ACIS writing.
PR page identifies schema/storage work #1174 as a dependency and shows no deployment.
limits: Not a released writer, deployed build, or semantic result.

observations: DWG import/export is delegated through an external converter and then shares DXF settings.
Converter selection includes LibreDWG, ODA File Converter, and QCAD Professional.
DXF import selects a C++ or legacy Python backend and exposes import filters, object creation choices, scale, joining, and grouping settings.
limits: Documentation repository is archived; treat as a versioned profile reference, not proof about an arbitrary current FreeCAD binary.

observations: Issue is closed as not planned; maintainer distinguishes explicit DXF entities from proprietary ACIS blobs and says stock FreeCAD cannot interpret the blobs.
limits: Does not establish behavior of optional add-ons, commercial translators, or future builds.

observations: LibreDWG 0.14.1 notes describe decompression capacity/logical-size, section/page offset, integer arithmetic, 3DSOLID block-size, and non-finite angle writer failure classes.
limits: Peer-specific release notes do not demonstrate analogous local defects.

plan_changes: Treat AC1021/R2007 as a test hypothesis for the DXF AcDb3dSolid subclass boundary and reconcile against ODA plus independently reopened outputs before production changes.
Strengthen existing generated group-1/3 SAT tests with exact chunk-limit, token-adjacent split, escape-boundary, exact reconstruction, and following-record cases.
Retain adversarial AcDs tests where directory position, sorted-handle rank, and entity traversal order differ.
Record exact FreeCAD converter, importer backend, relevant filters, object-creation mode, and unit scale at the composed consumer checkpoint; do not count stock FreeCAD as an ACIS semantic oracle.
Keep LibreDWG-inspired arithmetic/resource checks within current PAR-14/7BE and 7S.2/7S.3 owners; add local regressions only after mapping an analogous local path.
